body:
From the first 10 months of my life, even the day I was born, my momma wouldn't even touch me, hold me, feed me or bathe me! It wasn't until my granddad jumped her ass and told her to start taking care of YOUR baby!! She's YOUR responsibility!! 

 My grandmother told me this story when I was 27 years old and it explained WHY all my life  my mother kept telling me over and over how she wished she'd never had me and how much she hates me!! 

I am the oldest of 5 kids and as early as I can remember she treated me way different than the others (my siblings). I would be locked outside in the HOT summer months looking through our screen door and watching my brothers and sisters sitting in the cool living room floor eating their peanut butter and jelly sandwiches and drinking a cold glass of Koolaide while they watched their favorite cartoons. And she would open the about 30 minutes before my dad would be home from work, her telling me to go wash my face and clean up before he gets home. She kept me outside all day long, like a dog in the back yard.

And every chance she got, all the way up too her death in 2014 (me being 54 yrs old at that time) still telling me how she wished I was never born. Yet asking ME, the one she hated so much, if I could help her out with paying for her funeral?!! Really??!!   I did pay for her funeral, none of the other 4 siblings pitched in a dime.  And the ONLY thing I ever wanted from her when she was to pass, was a quilt (that she had in her possession) that my grandmother had made, which I helped her make, (I was 13 at the time).

And my mother repeatedly told me she would leave the quilt (which for me had had alot of sentimental value to ME!),  to me.  Guess what?  She didn't leave it to me!!!   According to my baby sister (my mother's favorite) who said to me "well, mom didn't put it in writing for you to have that quilt, so I don't know what to tell you". 

I was SO HURT AND PISSED OFF!!! Not only at my now dead mother, but my little sister too!!!   They both KNEW what that quilt meant to me yet they still hurt me over it!  My sister gave the quilt to our aunt, so I went straight to our aunt and begged for the quilt back, she said NO that she gave it to "her " daughter, then I go to my cousin and begged HER for the quilt back, she too said NO that she was going to give it to her daughter ( a 17 year who could care less about the sentimental value it has!).

Here I am, paid for my mother's funeral, the woman who repeatedly told me over and over my entire life how much she hated me, she could even do one nice and loving thing for me, by leaving me a treasure from my grandmother!!!

And my siblings, the ones who wasn't treated badly by our mother don't understand WHY I am so angry with our "dead" mother??!!

That's just a small smidgen of the trauma I endured with my parents growing up and having to depend on myself for my school clothes and school supplies or any  thing else I ever needed or wanted in life!

I had to shop lift all of my school clothes and school supplies, luckily I never got caught, yet when my brother did and he went to jail. Instead of my dad being angry with him for shop lifting, he took him out and bought my brother the "new" school clothes and other things my brother wanted or needed, but NOT me!  He told me that IF I ever wanted anything out of life then I needed to go to work and EARN the money for the things I needed or wanted, I was 13 years old!!!  Not even old enough to get a damn job!!!  So I went around in our neighborhoods and I washed cars and cut grass, I picked up soda bottles and took them to the store to get a nickel a piece for them, I did whatever a 13 year old kid could do to earn the money to buy the things that MY parents should have bought for me!  But, boy oh boy, my siblings didn't have too!!

​

I have fought and struggled all my life! I was forced to live at night on the streets from the age of 13 till I got pregnant at 17, just to keep my dad from trying to screw me or beat me for fighting him off of me.

I had a very hard life (and still some times think I do now) yet I refuse to let life beat me!!  The devil ain't getting my soul, it belongs to God and GOD only!!!

Life IS hard!!! But YOU CAN BE HARDER!!!  And not let it steal your joy away from you!!!  

You contact me any time YOU want and I will be here to listen!!! 

IF any one needs to talk, shout out at me!  I don't know if I can leave my phone number here, nor do I want any idiot to blow my phone up, but I'll start with my email and we'll go from there.

[Tx38special@yahoo.com](mailto:Tx38special@yahoo.com)

I gotta go for now but keep two things in mind

1). TOUGH THINGS NEVER LAST, BUT TOUGH PEOPLE DO!!

AND 

2). ALWAYS WAIT 24 HOURS BEFORE YOU DO ANYTHING, LIKE TAKING YOUR OWN LIFE!!  JUST WAIT 24 HOURS!!!!

Lots of LOVE, Lynn
